definitions.gloss: personal matter; private affair; private business
definitions.explanation: Something that belongs to one's private life rather than work or public affairs. Often used as a polite preface when bringing up personal topics in a professional or formal setting.

examples.japanese: {私事|しじ}で{恐縮|きょうしゅく}ですが。
examples.english: I'm sorry to bring up a personal matter, but...

examples.japanese: {私事|しじ}ではございますが、この{度|たび}{結婚|けっこん}いたしました。
examples.english: On a personal note, I recently got married.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}と{私事|しじ}はきちんと{分|わ}けるべきだ。
examples.english: One should properly separate work and personal matters.

notes:
Composed of {私|し} (private/personal) + {事|じ} (matter/affair). A formal word used especially in business and professional settings when introducing personal topics.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also sometimes read as わたくしごと, which sounds even more formal and humble.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私事|しじ}で{恐縮|きょうしゅく}ですが: I'm sorry to mention something personal, but...
- {私事|しじ}ではございますが: on a personal note (very polite)
- {私事|しじ}を{優先|ゆうせん}する: to prioritize personal matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個人的|こじんてき}なこと: personal thing — more casual, everyday usage
- {公私|こうし}: public and private (matters) — used for the contrast between work and personal life
- {私用|しよう}: personal use/business — focuses on activities done for personal reasons
